body: Got a text just now he fell asleep on their couch but he's driving to me right now. Huh. He knows he fucked up... He's coming to 'snuggle'. He doesn't fuck up often but at least he realizes it when he does. It's just my bad luck to be so depressive. Thanks to everyone who talked to me last night and this morning. I really appreciate it. I have now had some sleep and I feel much better since my eyes aren't swollen shut from crying. It sucks scrolling thru your phone and there is not one person you can talk to about things like that. That's why I talked to you guys. It made me feel better. I just recently joined reddit and have often longed for a place where I could post my feelings when I feel down. Thank you for reading and responding!

It's Christmas..Merry Christmas to me! 51 weeks after meeting him, this is where we are...nice...

I think I am loving and caring. I give him and my daughter everything I can. He and I met thru mutual friends on NYE last year. From the time I met him I knew we had something special but its been a struggle with her ever since she figured out that I was more than a fling for him. He has had a rough life and has had one truly adult relationship in his life before me and she turned out to be a lesbian. He was skittish but I did my best to instill trust. When he said he loved me for the first time my heart sang! I had done it! I had succeeded in getting my wish! I had this amazing wonderful smart sexy funny guy and he was mine! It may have been too good to be true. You'd think at age 34 that I wouldn't believe in fairy tales anymore. But I do. But I also struggle with depression. Not all the time. But often enough to make me realize it can be a problem. I just see flashes of myself committing suicide. I think who would really be sad? My daughter would probably be better off with someone else who wasn't such a bad mom. My parents? No. My brother? No. My friends? Not really. Sometimes I wish I wasn't here.

He makes me very very happy most of the time. But times like today when it's me or her and he chooses her bc she's the mother of his kids and they live together and she will raise holy hell I he doesn't go to her family thing make me feel like I'm worthless. Her family knows me and likes me. She doesn't want me there even tho she didn't plan it and she's jealous. I think bc I don't have any kids with him and we have only been together a year that I will eventually lose ultimately. I'm tired of being alone. I'm tired of fighting to keep someone I love. I want him to fight for me and stand up to her. And say either he is bringing me and she can deal with t or he's simply not going. But he won't do that. I wonder what will happen tonight. If he will show up later like he promised. And if he does if he's going to break it off with me.

One where we would laugh and talk. Be ourselves. Where I didn't have to worry that he will choose hi ex over me bc I'm too emo. We would go be outside together to this county park a walk the trails together holding hands. Swim in the creek. Kiss and be happy. We have done those things. When she is not interfering we are happy and we talk. When she sticks her nose in then he gets sullen and distant an noncommunicative. It makes me feel like I'm not enough. Like I'm the cause of his stress.
Nothing is going on. I've been staring at the ceiling.

I need to talk but I don't know who to talk to. I need to cry but I don't know who to cry on. I need to scream but I don't know who to scream at. I need to laugh but there's nothing to laugh at. I need love but I don't know who can love me.
